The Blinded Elf is one of  Auntie Ethel's victims. Her corpse is in the Entrance Gallery of the Overgrown Tunnel during Act One.
“
This poor dear wished never to lay eyes on her family again.
„
— Auntie Ethel, on the Blinded Elf's fate

Involvement

Act One

The Blinded Elf is near  Efrin in the Entrance Gallery of the Overgrown Tunnel.

Speak with Dead

The blinded elf can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Why did you go to the hag?
    • Blinded Elf
      My family took her... my baby girl...
      • Blinded Elf
        Pretended she... never existed...
        • Blinded Elf
          Told Ethel... never wanted... to see them again... she... took my eyes...
  • Why did your family take your child?
    • Blinded Elf
      They didn't like... me having something... they couldn't touch...
      • What can you tell me about Ethel?
        • Blinded Elf
          Doesn't matter... nothing matters... without... baby girl...
  • Is there anything I should know about this place?
    • Blinded Elf
      Run...
